verdict.rationale: Databricks documents first-party background automation. Lakeflow ETL pipelines handle orchestration, and Auto Loader and Structured Streaming process new data as it arrives. SQL alerts monitor query results and send notifications automatically, Jobs appears as a REST API and compute target, and Agent Runtime/AgentKit adds durable execution so agent runs survive restarts and crashes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduling or event triggers for jobs and agents, evidence that Genie Code runs unattended in the background (it is documented as asking for approval before using tools), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
